script_text: The stars are about to shake your world, Aries — Mars, your ruling fire-element planet, is charging back into your 1st House, igniting a revolution. Early this week, Saturn at zero degrees Aries sits in your 1st House, testing your patience, while the Moon clashes with Neptune on Tuesday, stirring confusion in your 10th House career. Wednesday is your turning point — Venus enters Libra, gliding into your 7th House of partnerships, bringing romantic energy. By Thursday, Mars fires up your 1st House with drive, and the weekend brings a trine between the Sun in Virgo and your natal Mars, supercharging career ambitions in your 10th House. Friday is your power day because Venus in your 7th House attracts a meaningful connection. Monday is your worst day — Saturn's square to natal Neptune creates hidden expenses in your 12th House. Channel Mars's return with one bold move. Follow for updates.
